name: mobile-ai-qa-boilerplate
description: Agentic mobile E2E boilerplate — WebdriverIO + Appium, driven by an AI loop: build → run → explore → report → decide.

scripts.setup: node -e "console.log('Put your .apk / .app in apps/, then point config/app.ts at it. See docs/guides/building-the-app.md.')"
scripts.wdio:ios: PLATFORM=ios node scripts/device-lock.mjs run --owner "wdio ios" -- wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts
scripts.wdio:android: npm run android:boot && PLATFORM=android node scripts/device-lock.mjs run --owner "wdio android" -- wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts
scripts.wdio:ios:debug: PLATFORM=ios node scripts/device-lock.mjs run --owner "wdio ios debug" -- wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts --mochaOpts.grep=@debug
scripts.wdio:android:debug: npm run android:boot && PLATFORM=android node scripts/device-lock.mjs run --owner "wdio android debug" -- wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts --mochaOpts.grep=@debug
scripts.wdio:ios:isolated: PLATFORM=ios ISOLATED=true node scripts/device-lock.mjs run --owner "wdio ios isolated" -- wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts
scripts.wdio:android:isolated: npm run android:boot && PLATFORM=android ISOLATED=true node scripts/device-lock.mjs run --owner "wdio android isolated" -- wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts
scripts.explore:ios: PLATFORM=ios node scripts/device-lock.mjs run --owner "explore ios" -- wdio run ./wdio.explore.conf.ts
scripts.explore:android: npm run android:boot && PLATFORM=android node scripts/device-lock.mjs run --owner "explore android" -- wdio run ./wdio.explore.conf.ts
